capability: Publish v1.1.0 as a canonical Windows x64 manual-only Application package
searchEvidence: scripts/package.ps1 is the sole package-construction owner. Its existing AllowPrerelease branch already projects the Application without either managed Launcher, so ManualOnly must extend that seam rather than introduce a second packager.

Release-manifest schema 1.1 is historical preview compatibility and ManagedPackageVerifier still admits it. A distinct schema 1.3 distributionMode=manual-only lets the existing Version flow reject the artifact fail-closed without changing Version runtime behavior.

The frozen v1.0.8 packager deterministically rejects six zero-byte Golden provenance placeholders before ZIP creation. Manual-only is a user runtime package, so it omits the entire reference/Golden evidence payload and leaves the v1.0.8 redistribution authority unchanged.

scripts/smoke-release.ps1 already owns closed inventory, hashes, SBOM/provenance, CRC worker and visible Application startup. It remains the only artifact smoke owner and gains only the schema 1.3 admission branch.

The owner explicitly excluded Launcher, Setup, Catalog, Registry, automatic update and Version deployment, and directed that v1.1.0 not rerun the full release workflow. The known full verifier shadow/repository-root failure is assigned to the v1.1.1 verification-architecture milestone.
terminalContract: Add one explicit -ManualOnly stable package mode to the existing packager. VERSION, executable metadata, source tag, ZIP, manifest, SBOM and provenance must all be 1.1.0. Emit schema 1.3 with distributionMode=manual-only; omit the ZIP managed Launcher, all Distribution Launcher assets, every reference/Golden payload, Bootstrap, Catalog and Registry handoff content. Preserve the existing managed stable and prerelease branches byte-for-policy. Smoke must reject any Launcher, Bootstrap or reference path in schema 1.3 while retaining the closed allowlist, hashes, sidecars, CRC worker and visible Application startup. The managed Version flow must continue to reject schema 1.3 through a real Infrastructure regression. Amend ADR 0062 only for this direct-package exception; managed-first remains authoritative for Setup and update. The controlled operator procedure requires independent exact-head review, merge to protected main, exact reviewed-tree equals merge-tree proof, one clean detached exact-main build with truthful manual-operator provenance, an absent stable tag, one annotated tag binding the exact main SHA/tree and three asset digests, and an exact three-asset GitHub Release consisting only of ZIP, SPDX SBOM and provenance. It then downloads all assets into a fresh fixed-D session, compares every digest, reruns closed package smoke and visibly starts the Application. Never move or replace an existing tag. Release notes must state Windows x64 manual ZIP only and exclude Launcher, Setup, Catalog, Registry, automatic update, Version deployment and reference payload. Do not change firmware composition, profiles, byte ranges, CRC behavior, runtime support, Catalog/Registry behavior or v1.0.8 source/history. By owner direction and the bounded dated waiver, do not run verify.py --all or the managed release workflow and never claim those gates green; run only release-contract tests, protected CI, package construction, package smoke, visible startup and fresh-download verification.

designReview.evidence: Independent R3 design re-review approved the bounded v1.1.0 manual-only distribution exception. ADR 0062 will retain managed-first authority for Setup/update while documenting the direct-package exception; schema 1.3 is fail-closed from managed Version installation through an Infrastructure regression; package.ps1 remains the single construction owner and ManualOnly guards every reference/Golden and Launcher/deployment path; the controlled operator procedure binds the independently reviewed and merge-tree-equivalent protected-main SHA/tree to one annotated tag and exactly ZIP, SPDX, and provenance assets, uses a truthful manual-operator builder identity, and independently re-downloads, hashes, inventories, worker-checks, and visibly starts the artifact in the fixed test area. No firmware, profile, composition, range, CRC, support, Catalog, Registry, or v1.0.8 authority changes. The supplemental R3 review accepts the one-release expansion of the v1.1.0 waiver to structure-only because the exact 2026-09-01 run reached the pre-existing capability-history scan after reporting only known metric warnings and zero validation errors, then exhausted the bounded 600-second execution window; this result is recorded as timed out and waived, not passed. ManualOnly remains locked to v1.1.0, excludes reference/Golden/Launcher/deployment content, uses a truthful builder identity, and its release-contract suite is 63/63 green. P0=0, P1=0, P2=0, P3=0; verdict PASS-WITH-HUMAN-GATE pending exact-head review, complete exact-tree owner waiver, protected-main applicable CI, managed schema-1.3 rejection, release-owner digest approval, and fresh-download visible-startup evidence.
